items.title: Lennar (LEN) Opens Two New Communities In Alabama And California
items.summary: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) has opened Cherokee Bend in Alabama and The Farm in California, adding two new planned communities to its portfolio. Both projects introduce new home designs with flexible layouts that can accommodate multigenerational households and changing space needs. The communities include shared amenities such as recreational areas and lifestyle facilities aimed at buyers seeking both affordability and resort-style living. items.summary: As mortgage rates rise, builders use incentives to boost home sales at the expense of their margins.

items.title: Lennar (LEN) Lags Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Lennar (LEN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -4.65% and -3.44%, respectively, for the quarter ended August 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Lennar Cuts Deliveries Target Again on Rate Pressure, Housing Market Conditions
items.summary: The homebuilding company said it expects full-year home deliveries of between 80,000 and 81,000 homes. That is down from its previous guidance for 82,000 to 83,000 deliveries, and below the 82,300 analysts polled by FactSet were expecting.

items.title: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) Misses Q3 CY2026 Sales Expectations
items.summary: Homebuilder Lennar (NYSE:LEN) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2026, with sales falling 8.7% year on year to $8.05 billion. Its GAAP profit of $1.19 per share was 7.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
